startupRecovery.reportReadyTimeoutAction: Copy the report and inspect the last completed stage. A running process alone does not prove the interface is ready.
startupRecovery.uiReadyTimeoutAction: Copy the diagnostic report and inspect the last completed stage. A running process alone is not readiness.
startupRecovery.instanceMissingAction: Copy this report and inspect the last completed stage. Start Code-Codex again explicitly; no repeated close request was issued.
startupRecovery.documentBlockedAction: Inspect the last navigation and execution-context events. Native requests remain blocked until the current document is verified; no write request is replayed.
